title: Deck tokens
rule: `applyDeckTokens` (from `@ahaslides-product/design/deck`, re-exported by `lib/audience.js` and `lib/canvas.js`) writes one `--aha-deck-*` ladder onto the deck element from the deck's ink. `applyDeck` (audience phone) and `applyCanvasDeck` (slide canvas) both write that same ladder, and each adds only its own extras. Everything drawn on a deck reads these tokens, so one call inks it for white and black ink, on a solid or a photo deck. Never hard-code a colour on a deck.
why: The slide canvas and the audience page are both cross-origin iframes that cannot see the host theme, so the ladder is resolved on the deck itself. The canvas components (buttons, count, status line, stepper) and the audience elements (answer list, chip, field, submit, slider, cards) are built on exactly these tokens.

sections.name: Ink ladder
sections.what: One ladder of the deck ink at fixed shares, plus the frosted surface (the opposite of the ink at 80, 60 and 50%). Shown here on a light, a dark and a photo deck: each swatch reads the live token.
sections.useWhen: text, hairlines, tracks, hover and pressed fills, chip outlines and frosted panels drawn on a deck: the slide canvas and the audience phone alike
sections.notFor: app screens outside the deck (they use the product tokens).

rules.label: Ink ladder
rules.value: `--aha-deck-ink-secondary` 76 · `-line` 24 · `-stroke-chip` 20 · `-stroke` 12 · `-stroke-hover` 60 · `-fill-active` 16 · `-fill-hover` 12 · `-fill` 8, each the deck ink at that share

rules.label: Surface
rules.value: `--aha-deck-surface` the opposite of the ink at 80 (on a dark deck lifted 8% toward the ink), `-surface-hover` 60, `-surface-disabled` 50; `-surface-deep` equals the surface on a light deck and is Deep Space at 80 on a dark one

rules.label: Deprecated
rules.value: `--aha-deck-ink-muted` → `-ink-secondary`, `--aha-deck-edge` → `-stroke`, `--aha-deck-edge-hover` → `-stroke-hover`: still written, as aliases, so older consumers keep working

sections.name: Deck containers and modals
sections.what: The one container model for every rounded rectangle on the canvas, a canvas extra written by applyCanvasDeck on top of the shared ladder so it resolves for white and black ink: fill, a 1px stroke on the large container (the count container draws none), a dashed 1px stroke for an empty slot only, radius lg 12 / sm 8, padding sm 12 / md 20 / lg 32. A canvas modal (the presenter leaderboard popup) is a large container on the modal fill over the modal backdrop.
sections.useWhen: any panel, card, counter or modal drawn inside the slide canvas
sections.notFor: app screens outside the canvas (they use the product surfaces). The audience phone's elements carry their own panels on the shared surface tokens.

rules.label: Container
rules.value: `--aha-deck-container-fill` (the ink at 8% on a solid deck, the frosted surface on a photo deck), `-stroke` (the ink at 20%, 1px), `-stroke-empty` (the ink at 24%, 1px dashed, an empty slot only), `-radius-lg` 12 / `-radius-sm` 8, `-padding-sm` 12 / `-md` 20 / `-lg` 32. The large container draws the 1px stroke (the small count container draws none); a dimmed container (a wrong option once the answer is revealed) dims its stroke with its content instead of keeping it at full strength

rules.label: Modal
rules.value: panel `--aha-deck-modal-fill` (the opposite of the ink at 92%: white under black ink, Deep Space under white ink, so the slide behind barely shows) with `backdrop-filter: blur(var(--aha-blur-md))`, `-container-stroke`, `-container-radius-lg`, `-container-padding-lg`; behind it `--aha-deck-modal-backdrop` (black 40%). Close to the presenter leaderboard popup: white 80% with dark text on a light deck, black 75% with white text on a dark one

shared: **Shared by the canvas and the audience phone.** One ladder, one set of names: the canvas adds its button variables and the container and modal set below; the audience adds its accent set (`--aha-deck-accent-*`). The old audience names `--aha-deck-ink-muted`, `--aha-deck-edge` and `--aha-deck-edge-hover` are still written as deprecated aliases of `-ink-secondary`, `-stroke` and `-stroke-hover`; move to the new names.
